name: encode_gtex_concordance
description: Consensus-accessible gene sets (ENCODE ATAC-seq/DNase-seq) intersected with GTEx tissue-enriched genes per tissue

inputs.name: accessible_genes_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-biosample accessible-gene set subdirectories (output of encode_accessible_genes or encode_accessibility_contrast). Each subdir must contain geneset.tsv (header: gene) and optionally geneset.meta.json with 'biosample' field.

inputs.name: accessible_genes_zip
inputs.description: Zip archive of per-biosample accessible-gene set subdirectories. Alternative to accessible_genes_dir.

inputs.name: gtex_enriched_dir
inputs.description: Directory of gtex_tissue_enriched output subdirectories (each subdir named GTEx_tissue_enriched_<tissue> with geneset.tsv). Preferred over gtex_tstat_tsv when pre-computed enriched sets are available.

inputs.name: gtex_tstat_tsv
inputs.description: GTEx t-statistic matrix TSV (genes x tissues, first column gene symbol, remaining columns tissue t-stats). Derived from GTEx V8 median TPM at https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/bulk-gex/v8/rna-seq/GTEx_Analysis_2017-06-05_v8_RNASeQCv1.1.9_gene_median_tpm.gct.gz. Used when gtex_enriched_dir is not provided.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: Assay label for set names and provenance (e.g. 'ATAC-seq', 'DNase-seq'). Default 'ATAC-seq'.

parameters.name: consensus_fraction
parameters.help: Minimum fraction of ENCODE biosamples in which a gene must be accessible to be included in the consensus (default: 0.25). At least 2 biosamples required regardless.

parameters.name: tstat_threshold
parameters.help: GTEx t-statistic threshold for tissue enrichment when loading from gtex_tstat_tsv (default: 4.0). Ignored when gtex_enriched_dir is provided.

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_consensus_x_GTEx_enriched_<tissue>/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: GMT file with consensus-accessible x GTEx-enriched genes for this tissue
